text: The minimum supported version of argon2-cffi is increased from 19.1.0 to 19.2.0.
suggestion_reason: argon2-cffi has a new minimum installed version.

text: The new FromWKB() and FromWKT() functions allow creating geometries from Well-known binary (WKB) and Well-known text (WKT) representations.
suggestion_reason: Application code can call the new FromWKB and FromWKT functions.

text: The admin's font stack now prefers system UI fonts and no longer requires downloading fonts. Additionally, CSS variables are available to more easily override the default font families.
suggestion_reason: The admin's fonts and CSS overrides change visible styling.

text: Django now supports psycopg version 3.1.8 or higher. To update your code, install the psycopg library, you don't need to change the ENGINE as django.db.backends.postgresql supports both libraries.
suggestion_reason: The supported psycopg driver version is a deployment dependency.

text: The Meta.index_together option is deprecated in favor of the django.db.models.Options.indexes option.
suggestion_reason: Replacing index_together concerns the database index definition.

text: The django-db-logger logger now logs transaction management queries (BEGIN, COMMIT, and ROLLBACK) at the DEBUG level.
suggestion_reason: Transaction statements now appear in DEBUG log output.

text: Model now provides asynchronous versions of some methods that use the database, using an a prefix: Model.adelete, Model.arefresh_from_db, and Model.asave.
suggestion_reason: Model gains named async methods for code to call.

text: The new makemigrations --update option merges model changes into the latest migration and optimizes the resulting operations.
suggestion_reason: makemigrations --update changes generated migration operations.

text: JSONField and its associated lookups and aggregates used to allow passing JSON encoded string literals which caused ambiguity on whether string literals were already encoded from database backend's perspective.
suggestion_reason: Encoded JSON literals affect JSONField database value semantics.

text: In order to avoid updating unnecessary columns, QuerySet.update_or_create now passes update_fields to the Model.save() calls. As a consequence, any fields modified in the custom save() methods should be added to the update_fields keyword argument before calling super(). See overriding-model-methods for more details.
suggestion_reason: Custom save methods must handle the update_fields argument correctly.

text: The DEFAULT_FILE_STORAGE setting is deprecated in favor of STORAGES["default"].
suggestion_reason: The file-storage setting name changes in project configuration.

text: The new STORAGES setting allows configuring multiple custom file storage backends. It also controls storage engines for managing files (the "default" key) and static files (the "staticfiles" key).
suggestion_reason: STORAGES configures file and static-file backend choices.

text: The arrayfield.overlap lookup now supports QuerySet.values() and values_list() as a right-hand side.
suggestion_reason: The array overlap lookup changes accepted ORM query inputs.

text: Also, the new django.db.migrations.operations.AlterModelTableComment operation allows changing table comments defined in the Meta.db_table_comment.
suggestion_reason: AlterModelTableComment is a database migration operation.

text: django.middleware.gzip.GZipMiddleware now includes a mitigation for the BREACH attack. It will add up to 100 random bytes to gzip responses to make BREACH attacks harder. Read more about the mitigation technique in the Heal The Breach (HTB) paper.
suggestion_reason: GZipMiddleware changes compressed HTTP response bytes.

text: Added support and translations for the Central Kurdish (Sorani) language.
suggestion_reason: The new translation changes language shown in the interface.

text: inspectdb now uses display_size from DatabaseIntrospection.get_table_description() rather than internal_size for CharField.
suggestion_reason: inspectdb changes how a CharField is inferred from database metadata.

text: django.http.StreamingHttpResponse now supports async iterators when Django is served via ASGI.
suggestion_reason: StreamingHttpResponse can consume async iterators under ASGI.

text: django.contrib.auth.forms.UserCreationForm now saves many-to-many form fields for a custom user model.
suggestion_reason: UserCreationForm now saves many-to-many values to persistent data.

text: Support and translations for the Uyghur language are now available.
suggestion_reason: The new translation changes user-visible language.

text: Passing a response object and a form/formset name to SimpleTestCase.assertFormError() and assertFormSetError() is no longer allowed.
suggestion_reason: The two test assertion methods no longer accept those call arguments.

text: django.forms.BoundField.as_field_group renders fields with the "django/forms/field.html" template by default and can be customized on a per-project, per-field, or per-request basis. See reusable-field-group-templates.
suggestion_reason: BoundField.as_field_group changes the template used to render a field.

text: The new MessagesTestMixin.assertMessages assertion method allows testing django.contrib.messages added to a response.
suggestion_reason: Tests can call the new assertMessages assertion method.

text: The new django.forms.URLField.assume_scheme argument for django.forms.URLField allows specifying a default URL scheme.
suggestion_reason: URLField gains a named argument for form code.

text: The minimum supported version of colorama is increased to 0.4.6.
suggestion_reason: colorama has a new minimum installed version.

text: Support for cx_Oracle is deprecated in favor of oracledb 1.3.2+ Python driver.
suggestion_reason: The supported Oracle Python driver changes for deployment.

text: Under ASGI, http.disconnect events are now handled. This allows views to perform any necessary cleanup if a client disconnects before the response is generated. See async-handling-disconnect for more details.
suggestion_reason: Async view code can handle client disconnects for cleanup.

text: AuthenticationMiddleware now adds an HttpRequest.auser asynchronous method that returns the currently logged-in user.
suggestion_reason: HttpRequest gains the auser method for code to call.

text: django.test.AsyncClient now supports the follow parameter.
suggestion_reason: AsyncClient gains a follow parameter in test code.

text: Under the hood the provided choices are normalized into a list of 2-tuples as the canonical form whenever the choices value is updated. For more information, please check the model field reference on choices.
suggestion_reason: Updated choices are normalized into a new canonical Python value shape.

text: The new create_defaults argument of QuerySet.update_or_create and QuerySet.aupdate_or_create methods allows specifying a different field values for the create operation.
suggestion_reason: update_or_create gains a create_defaults call argument.

text: File.open now passes all positional (*args) and keyword arguments (**kwargs) to Python's built-in open.
suggestion_reason: File.open forwards its positional and keyword call arguments.

text: Support for pre-releases of MySQL 8.0.x series is removed. Django 5.0 supports MySQL 8.0.11 and higher.
suggestion_reason: MySQL 8.0.11 or later is required in the deployed database.

text: Running the makemigrations command will generate a migration containing a no-op AlterField operation.
suggestion_reason: makemigrations generates an AlterField operation, even if it is a no-op.

text: The django.contrib.admin.AllValuesFieldListFilter, ChoicesFieldListFilter, RelatedFieldListFilter, and RelatedOnlyFieldListFilter admin filters now handle multi-valued query parameters.
suggestion_reason: Admin list filters now handle multi-value query parameters in the interface.

text: The new GEOSGeometry.equals_identical method allows point-wise equivalence checking of geometries.
suggestion_reason: GEOSGeometry gains a named geometry-comparison method.

text: Serialization of functions decorated with functools.cache or functools.lru_cache is now supported without the need to write a custom serializer.
suggestion_reason: Cached functions can now be serialized into migrations.

text: Following the release of Django 5.0, we suggest that third-party app authors drop support for all versions of Django prior to 4.2. At that time, you should be able to run your package's tests using python -Wd so that deprecation warnings appear. After making the deprecation warning fixes, your app should be compatible with Django 5.0.
suggestion_reason: Third-party app code should fix deprecations for Django 5.0 compatibility.

text: OGRGeometry.centroid is now available on all supported geometry types.
suggestion_reason: OGRGeometry gains a centroid property for code to read.

text: Passing positional arguments to Model.save and Model.asave is deprecated in favor of keyword-only arguments.
suggestion_reason: Model.save and asave callers must move positional values to keywords.

text: The new Expression.constraint_validation_compatible attribute allows specifying that the expression should be ignored during a constraint validation.
suggestion_reason: Expression gains a Python attribute controlling validation behavior.

text: The new django.contrib.auth.middleware.LoginRequiredMiddleware redirects all unauthenticated requests to a login page. Views can allow unauthenticated requests by using the new django.contrib.auth.decorators.login_not_required decorator.
suggestion_reason: The note names both middleware redirect behavior and a view decorator; routing setup and code are plausible first checks.

text: django.contrib.sessions.backends.cached_db.SessionStore now handles exceptions when storing session information in the cache, logging proper error messages with their traceback via the newly added sessions logger.
suggestion_reason: The note changes session-cache storage handling and error-log output; both checks are explicit.

text: The new django.contrib.auth.forms.AdminUserCreationForm and the existing django.contrib.auth.forms.AdminPasswordChangeForm now support disabling password-based authentication by setting an unusable password on form save. This is now available in the admin when visiting the user creation and password change pages.
suggestion_reason: The form saves an unusable password and changes admin page behavior; data/auth state and UI checks both matter.

text: The new Operation.category attribute allows specifying an operation category used by the makemigrations to display a meaningful symbol for the operation.
suggestion_reason: makemigrations now prints different symbols in command output.

text: In order to improve accessibility, the expandable widget used for ModelAdmin.fieldsets and InlineModelAdmin.fieldsets, when the fieldset has a name and use the collapse class, now includes <details> and <summary> elements.
suggestion_reason: The fieldset renders new details and summary HTML elements.

text: django.test.SimpleTestCase.assertContains, django.test.SimpleTestCase.assertNotContains, and django.test.SimpleTestCase.assertInHTML assertions now add haystacks to assertion error messages.
suggestion_reason: Assertion failure messages now include haystack text.

text: The new django.core.validators.DomainNameValidator validates domain names, including internationalized domain names. The new django.core.validators.validate_domain_name function returns an instance of django.core.validators.DomainNameValidator.
suggestion_reason: Code can call the new domain-name validator class or function.

text: The TransactionTestCase.assertQuerysetEqual() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: Test code calling assertQuerysetEqual must change.

text: "pool" option is now supported in OPTIONS on PostgreSQL to allow using connection pools.
suggestion_reason: The PostgreSQL connection pool is selected through database OPTIONS.

text: The makemigrations command now displays meaningful symbols for each operation to highlight operation categories.
suggestion_reason: makemigrations displays symbols for operation categories.

text: In order to improve accessibility and enable screen readers to associate fieldsets with their help text, the form fieldset now includes the aria-describedby HTML attribute.
suggestion_reason: The form fieldset renders an aria-describedby attribute.

text: Custom tags may now set extra data on the Parser object that will later be made available on the Template instance. Such data may be used, for example, by the template loader, or other template clients.
suggestion_reason: Custom template-tag code can pass data through Parser to Template.

text: ModelAdmin.list_display now supports using __ lookups to list fields from related models.
suggestion_reason: list_display can show related-model fields in the admin table.

text: FromWKB() and FromWKT() functions now support the optional srid argument (except for Oracle where it is ignored).
suggestion_reason: FromWKB and FromWKT gain an optional srid call argument.

text: QuerySet.order_by now supports ordering by annotation transforms such as JSONObject keys and ArrayAgg indices.
suggestion_reason: order_by changes supported ordering of ORM query results.

text: GeoIP2.country now exposes the continent_code, continent_name, and is_in_european_union values.
suggestion_reason: GeoIP2.country exposes additional return-value keys.

text: BaseDatabaseOperations.adapt_decimalfield_value() is now a no-op, simply returning the given value.
suggestion_reason: A database-backend method now returns its input unchanged.

text: django.urls.reverse and django.urls.reverse_lazy now accept query and fragment keyword arguments, allowing the addition of a query string and/or fragment identifier in the generated URL, respectively.
suggestion_reason: reverse and reverse_lazy gain query and fragment keyword arguments.

text: Built-in aggregate functions accepting only one argument (Avg, Count, Max, Min, StdDev, Sum, and Variance) now raise TypeError when called with an incorrect number of arguments.
suggestion_reason: Aggregate function calls now raise TypeError for wrong argument counts.

text: A new warning is displayed when running runserver, indicating that it is unsuitable for production. This warning can be suppressed by setting the DJANGO_RUNSERVER_HIDE_WARNING environment variable to "true".
suggestion_reason: An environment variable controls the runserver warning.

text: CharField.max_length is no longer required to be set on SQLite, which supports unlimited VARCHAR columns.
suggestion_reason: SQLite CharField schema no longer requires max_length.

text: Each serialization format now defines a Deserializer class, rather than a function, to improve extensibility when defining a custom serialization format.
suggestion_reason: Custom serializers now extend a Deserializer class rather than a function.

text: All django.utils.feedgenerator.SyndicationFeed classes now support a stylesheets attribute. If specified, an <? xml-stylesheet ?> processing instruction will be added to the top of the document for each stylesheet in the given list. See feed-stylesheets for more details.
suggestion_reason: A stylesheet processing instruction is added to feed output.

text: The new preserve_request argument for django.http.HttpResponseRedirect and django.http.HttpResponsePermanentRedirect determines whether the HTTP status codes 302/307 or 301/308 are used, respectively.
suggestion_reason: The redirect response can use different HTTP status codes.

text: django.utils.html.format_html_join now supports taking an iterable of mappings, passing their contents as keyword arguments to django.utils.html.format_html.
suggestion_reason: format_html_join accepts mapping values passed as keyword arguments.

text: The admin/base.html template now has a new block extrabody for adding custom code before the closing </body> tag.
suggestion_reason: The admin template gains a block affecting rendered page content.

text: coveredby and covers lookup are now supported on MySQL.
suggestion_reason: MySQL now supports these spatial ORM lookups.

text: An django.forms.BoundField.aria_describedby property is added to BoundField to ease use of this HTML attribute in templates.
suggestion_reason: BoundField exposes ARIA description text for rendered templates.

text: The new django.template.Library.simple_block_tag decorator enables the creation of simple block tags, which can accept and use a section of the template.
suggestion_reason: Library gains a decorator for defining custom block tags.

text: Data loaded from django.test.TransactionTestCase.fixtures and from migrations enabled with serialized_rollback=True are now available during TransactionTestCase.setUpClass().
suggestion_reason: Test fixture data becomes available earlier in setUpClass.

text: MySQL connections now default to using the utf8mb4 character set, instead of utf8, which is an alias for the deprecated character set utf8mb3. utf8mb3 can be specified in the OPTIONS part of the DATABASES setting, if needed for legacy databases.
suggestion_reason: The MySQL connection charset default and DATABASES option change.

text: Support for subclasses of RemoteUserMiddleware that override process_request() without overriding aprocess_request() is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: RemoteUserMiddleware subclasses need an async override.

text: The new django.db.models.CompositePrimaryKey allows tables to be created with a primary key consisting of multiple fields.
suggestion_reason: CompositePrimaryKey changes the database primary-key schema.

text: The model pages are now restricted to users with the corresponding view or change permissions.
suggestion_reason: Permissions now change which admindocs model pages are visible.

text: The django.template.context_processors.debug context processor is no longer included in the default project template.
suggestion_reason: The default project template omits a context processor setting.

text: Model fields, indexes, and constraints from django.contrib.postgres now include system checks to verify that django.contrib.postgres is an installed app.
suggestion_reason: The system check verifies django.contrib.postgres is installed.

text: Notably, the return type of the EmailMessage.message() method is now an instance of Python's email.message.EmailMessage. This supports the same API as the previous SafeMIMEText and SafeMIMEMultipart return types, but is not an instance of those now-deprecated classes.
suggestion_reason: EmailMessage.message returns a different Python object type.

text: The get_joining_columns() method of ForeignObject and ForeignObjectRel is removed.
suggestion_reason: The removed ForeignObject method requires call-site review.

text: The URLIZE_ASSUME_HTTPS transitional setting is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: The transitional HTTPS setting is deprecated.

text: The new GEOSGeometry.hasm property checks whether the geometry has the M dimension.
suggestion_reason: GEOSGeometry gains the hasm property for code to read.

text: Constraints now implement a check() method that is already registered with the check framework.
suggestion_reason: Constraints gain a registered check method.

text: If the database supports UPDATE … RETURNING statements, backends can set DatabaseFeatures.can_return_rows_from_update=True.
suggestion_reason: Database backends can set a named DatabaseFeatures attribute.

text: In Django 6.0, DEFAULT_AUTO_FIELD now defaults to django.db.models.BigAutoField and the aforementioned lines in the project and app templates are removed.
suggestion_reason: A configuration default changes and can affect database primary-key schema; both checks are explicit.

text: Django now includes a built-in Tasks framework for running code outside the HTTP request–response cycle. This enables offloading work, such as sending emails or processing data, to background workers.
suggestion_reason: The new Tasks API and background worker deployment are both plausible first checks.

text: The new AdminSite.password_change_form attribute allows customizing the form used in the admin site password change view.
suggestion_reason: AdminSite gains an attribute for selecting a password-change form.

text: The querystring template tag now consistently prefixes the returned query string with a ?, ensuring reliable link generation behavior.
suggestion_reason: The querystring tag changes URLs rendered in links.

text: The new django.core.paginator.AsyncPaginator and django.core.paginator.AsyncPage provide async implementations of django.core.paginator.Paginator and django.core.paginator.Page respectively.
suggestion_reason: AsyncPaginator and AsyncPage are new classes for code to use.

text: EmailMessage.attach() now accepts a email.message.MIMEPart object from Python's modern email API.
suggestion_reason: EmailMessage.attach accepts a new MIMEPart argument type.

text: django.contrib.staticfiles.storage.ManifestStaticFilesStorage now ensures consistent path ordering in manifest files, making them more reproducible and reducing unnecessary diffs.
suggestion_reason: The static-files manifest output now has stable path ordering.

text: The startproject and startapp commands now create the custom target directory if it doesn't exist.
suggestion_reason: Project setup commands now create a missing target directory.

text: All parameters must be passed as keyword arguments when creating an EmailMessage or EmailMultiAlternatives instance, except for the first four (subject, body, from_email, and to), which may still be passed either as positional or keyword arguments.
suggestion_reason: EmailMessage constructors now restrict positional arguments.

text: Built-in support for the Content Security Policy (CSP) standard is now available, making it easier to protect web applications against content injection attacks such as cross-site scripting (XSS). CSP allows declaring trusted sources of content by giving browsers strict rules about which scripts, styles, images, or other resources can be loaded.
suggestion_reason: CSP trusted-source policy is an application security configuration.

text: The undocumented encoding property of django.core.mail.EmailMessage no longer supports Python legacy email.charset.Charset objects.
suggestion_reason: EmailMessage.encoding no longer accepts a legacy Charset object.

text: Serialization of deconstructible objects now supports keyword arguments with names that are not valid Python identifiers.
suggestion_reason: Migration serialization now supports unusual keyword names.

text: Fixed a data corruption possibility in file_move_safe() when allow_overwrite=True, where leftover content from a previously larger file could remain after overwriting with a smaller one due to lack of truncation (36298).
suggestion_reason: The file overwrite fix prevents persistent file-content corruption.

text: Fixed a crash in Django 5.2 when filtering against a composite primary key using a tuple containing expressions (36522).
suggestion_reason: A composite-key filter changes ORM query behavior.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 6.0 that caused django.db.models.query.QuerySet.bulk_create to crash when introspecting the connection on SQLite (36818).
suggestion_reason: bulk_create on SQLite changes ORM data-write behavior.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused a crash when annotating aggregate expressions over query that uses explicit grouping by transforms followed by field references (36292).
suggestion_reason: Aggregate annotations and grouping change ORM query behavior.

text: Fixed a regression in Django 5.2 that caused the object-tools block to be rendered twice when using custom admin templates with overridden blocks due to changes in the base admin page block structure (36331).
suggestion_reason: Custom admin templates no longer render object tools twice.
